title: Wash Day Anthem (carwash, 4 minutes)

request.prompt: polished 1970s-inspired funk production, live band feel, warm analog sound, wonder, warmth, optimism and a little mischief, syncopated 3+3+2 rhythm in 4/4, instrumental, D major, 124 bpm, 1970s disco-funk, handclaps, wah guitar, funky bass, brass stabs, clavinet, congas, string swoops. Pull in: vinyl-warm intro, handclaps count in, bass walks up to the one. Pre-soak: tight funk groove, wah guitar chicks on the offbeat, water-drip percussion. Foam: bubbly Rhodes and clavinet, bouncing bass, shaker, playful horn stabs answer each other. Brushes: full groove, driving drums, big brass riff in 3+3+2, handclaps on 2 and 4, string swoops. Rinse: breakdown, bass and congas, filtered sweep, tension rising. Wax and dry: groove returns smooth and shiny, wah guitar solo, hi-hat shimmer. Detailing: sparkling vibraphone and glockenspiel, light and proud, bass keeps the groove. Finale: big brass hit, final riff, rings out on a clean D major chord. No humming, no 8-bit, no chiptune, no retro video-game music, no cheesy, no kazoo, no horror, no aggressive, no distorted guitar, no dubstep, no vocals, no lyrics, no singing, no MIDI, no sequenced
